meta.title: feat: Cache RPC health check in local storage for 1 hour
meta.body_summary: Add localStorage caching for RPC health check with 1-hour expiration to reduce redundant API calls on every page load and improve app initialization performance.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added localStorage caching for RPC health checks with 1-hour TTL; maintainer approved with a design note, merged after ~2.8h.

review_details.concern_detail: Approved with a non‑blocking note: 'We really need a generic localStorageOfDefault function to correctly type the returning value & default value.' No changes were requested for this PR.
review_details.performance_claim: Caching RPC health check in local storage for 1 hour reduces unnecessary API calls and speeds up app initialization.

core_change_summary.description: Added rpcHealthCacheKey in consts and implemented getInitialRpcEndpoints caching in networkConfig/local.ts using localStorage with a 1‑hour TTL. The cache avoids redundant API calls on every page load.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: util.ts and index.ts changes support the caching logic; pnpm-lock.yaml was updated for dependencies.
change_trajectory: Implement caching: add cache key, get/set helpers, modify getInitialRpcEndpoints to check cache first.
Maintainer polished constant naming and amended cache key.
